title: Implement attention and audit a decoder
promptMarkdown: Implement complete standard-library scaled dot-product attention with stable softmax, dimension checks, explicit allowed-key masks and a clear error for an all-masked row. Reproduce problem1; test row sums, exact forbidden weights, invariance to common score shifts, and unmasked permutation equivariance on three supplied distinct token vectors of your choice. Include code and observed checks. Then audit a next-token trainer that uses sequence[A, B, C] as both inputs and same-position targets, applies a lower-triangular mask including the diagonal, and reports accuracy on overlapping windows randomly split from the same documents after selecting its checkpoint on that named test split. Give a corrected target/mask/split/evaluation protocol and distinguish low token loss from factual or causal understanding.
hintLadder: A correct causal mask still permits the current input token.
Trace the original source of every overlapping window before splitting.
Use numeric checks for the operator and a separate protocol argument for predictive evidence.

criteria.criterion: Implements validated stable attention with honest all-masked handling
